verdict.rationale: incident.io documents on-call schedules, rotations, shadow schedules and importing personal holidays alongside shifts. Nothing in the evidence describes an engineer taking an override, swapping a shift, or requesting coverage without an admin. The holiday import and general schedule-building claims are adjacent features, not self-serve shift changes.

support.subject: As an on-call engineer, I can take an override, swap a shift, or request coverage without an admin rebuilding the schedule
